idleControl.scope: Before and after each tool's serial trial block; not a conversion from Unix load and not a Microsoft-prescribed threshold.
idleControl.duringActions: Record CPU and queue continuously. Workload-created high CPU is not an exclusion by itself; external interference or uncertain attribution is recorded separately.

instrumentation.timing: Record the native event timestamp, handler start and result-painted completion, with explicit completion predicates.
instrumentation.longTasks: Keep full durations for entries overlapping the action; separate page-load and idle entries. Drain observer records after completion.
instrumentation.attribution: Record Long Animation Frame script details or a supported trace when available; frame duration is not substituted for task duration.
instrumentation.controls: Record idle and small-input controls; postpone large input if observer/gateway interference or missing action marks prevents reliable timing.
instrumentation.zeroLongTasks: Say no task >=50 ms was observed, not a measured maximum of zero.

outputs: Chinese pilot report and evidence archive
